headline: AI-read chest X-rays flagged 18,377 people for tuberculosis testing in Delhi slums, and 877 were confirmed.
score_reason: Lowered from 5 to 4: the study was published on 23 Aug 2026, before the 7 Oct window.
importance_line: The news is a PTI report of an August study on AI chest X-rays in Delhi slums, which matters first to slum residents who may be missed by symptom checks, and the honest doubt is that only 877 of the 18,377 people flagged were confirmed with TB.
summary: PTI reports, as carried by ThePrint, that an AI tool which read chest X-rays flagged 18,377 of 168,568 people screened in Delhi's urban slums for tuberculosis (TB) testing, and molecular tests confirmed TB in 877 of the 16,866 who completed them. The study was published on 23 August 2026 in the Indian Journal of Tuberculosis, so the findings are six weeks old, and the AI did not make the final diagnosis, which came from sputum (phlegm) samples sent for molecular testing.
